tasks.instruction: Write a discussion response. An effective response contains at least 100 words.

professor.name: Doctor Achebe
professor.text: In our textbook, we read that parks and other green spaces with trees and plants have numerous benefits for people in cities. But city governments sometimes must choose between using a piece of available land as a green space or using it for other important purposes, such as for shopping areas or for manufacturing plants. In your opinion, which is the better use for available urban space? Why?

posts.name: Kelly
posts.text: It's true that parks can benefit people in cities, especially health-wise. But it's more important to use the limited space for things that people cannot survive without, like hospitals or clinics. Medical care is often an urgent necessity. Visiting a park is not.

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: I'm all for creating green spaces for people to enjoy, but you don't necessarily need an open piece of land to do that. Let the available land be used for business or housing purposes. Green spaces can be created on the rooftops of existing buildings. And new buildings can be constructed creatively to include open spaces with plants and trees.

tasks.sample: I believe that establishing an open green space would be a better option. While Claire‘s suggestion of creating green spaces on rooftops of both business and residential buildings does have its merits in terms of maximizing urban space, there are significant concerns to consider. One major issue is accessibility, as rooftop green spaces would only be accessible to those who live or work in the respective buildings. Unfortunately, this means that a large portion of the population would not have access to such spaces. Therefore, it would be more beneficial to establish an open green space that can be utilized and enjoyed by everyone. Additionally, rooftop green spaces may not significantly contribute to the overall city view since most people would not have the opportunity to view them from a higher point. On the other hand, an open green space would undeniably enhance the liveliness and natural ambiance of the neighborhood, providing an enjoyable view for all. (157 words)
